name: What are common challenges during ADU permit coordination?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges during ADU permit coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during ADU permit coordination include navigating complex local zoning ordinances, addressing conflicting interpretations of state and local ADU laws, and managing multiple rounds of revisions requested by planning departments. A practical tradeoff homeowners face is deciding whether to invest in professional coordination to mitigate these complexities or handle it themselves, potentially leading to longer timelines and unforeseen hurdles. Our team helps anticipate and resolve these issues to keep the process moving.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include navigating complex zoning, conflicting regulations, and multiple revisions. Professional coordination mitigates these issues.
